about.description: The public catalog of provisioner packages for hyperweaver-agent and zoneweaver-agent, with per-organization private catalogs behind STARTcloud sign-in.
about.goal: One place to find, trust and deploy every provisioner an organization publishes.

features.catalogs: Public catalog plus private catalogs per organization
features.tiers: Quality tiers measured on every data run
features.watches: Watch provisioners and get notified of releases
features.deploy: Deploy a provisioner straight into Hyperweaver

data.releases: Publishes catalog.json from each repository's GitHub releases

data.tiers: Measures quality tiers and health every run

web.signIn: STARTcloud sign-in with PKCE and DPoP
